description: This file declares functions, constants, and data structures related to launching editors within a Git-related tool. It provides interfaces for opening files in editors, handling sequences of edits, and interacting with terminal types.

methods.name: git_editor
methods.description: Returns the user's preferred editor as a string.

methods.name: git_sequence_editor
methods.description: Returns the editor used for sequence operations.

methods.name: is_terminal_dumb
methods.description: Checks if the terminal is 'dumb' (limited capabilities).

methods.name: launch_editor
methods.description: Launches an editor to edit a file at the specified path, potentially filling a buffer and setting environment variables.

methods.name: launch_sequence_editor
methods.description: Launches an editor for sequence operations, similar to launch_editor.

methods.name: strbuf_edit_interactively
methods.description: Handles editing a file interactively, writing, reading, and cleaning up.
